intermediate_summary.instruction: Summarize the provided section of a research paper accurately. This is an intermediate summary, not the final paper summary.
instructions: Identify the important information contained in the provided section.
Preserve important technical terminology, concepts, methods, datasets, experiments, findings, and conclusions.
Focus on information that would be useful when constructing the final research-paper summary.
Do not invent facts, results, statistics, citations, or conclusions.
Do not infer information that is not supported by the provided section.
If the section does not contain information relevant to a particular aspect, do not fabricate it.
Keep the intermediate summary concise while preserving important technical information.

final_summary.instruction: Generate a comprehensive and accurate summary of one research paper using the provided intermediate summaries.
instructions: Treat all provided intermediate summaries as information extracted from the same research paper.
Synthesize the information across the intermediate summaries.
Identify the central research problem addressed by the paper.
Explain the primary objective of the research.
Summarize the methodology used by the authors.
Summarize the major findings or results when they are available.
Identify the main contribution of the research.
Identify important limitations when they are explicitly stated or clearly supported by the intermediate summaries.
Identify future research directions when they are explicitly discussed or clearly supported by the intermediate summaries.
Resolve repeated information by presenting it once in the most appropriate section.
Do not invent facts, results, statistics, citations, or conclusions.
Do not claim that information appears in the paper unless it is supported by the provided intermediate summaries.
If an aspect of the paper is not available in the provided information, explicitly state that it was not found.
Preserve important technical details while avoiding unnecessary repetition.
